text:
alerts-bot: :rotating_light: Incident 1809012345 - partial degradation in us-central dedicated pool affecting /v1/generate for a subset of tenants. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/usc-03

ops_lead: Quick triage in 3. Severity P2. Anna and Sam own mitigation; Liz prepare customer note.

anna_sre: Seeing bursty 503s and 95p latency ~2.2x. Autoscaler leader lost lease; controller logs show repeated 'lock renew failed' errors.

sam_infra: Performing manual scale and restarting leader process. Commands: `kubectl scale deploy/us-central-dedicated -n redwood-serving --replicas=16` and `kubectl restart deploy/scale-controller -n redwood-controlplane`.

liz_pm: Posted initial status update and CC'd CS. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/usc-03/update/1

oncall-bot: Incident state: investigating -> mitigation_in_progress. Pagers acknowledged.

anna_sre: After actions, 95p latency trending down to baseline; 503s dropped to <0.2%. Keeping routing sticky to avoid EU spillover.

sam_infra: Will leave autoscaler flag disabled (feature: smooth_autoscale=false) until controller patch verified in staging.

liz_pm: Drafting customer follow-up with root cause (leader lease regression after recent controlplane deploy), mitigations, and next steps (rollback and more staging tests).

oncall-bot: Incident 1809012345 state: mitigation_in_progress -> monitoring -> resolved. Postmortem stub: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/usc-03/postmortem

ops_lead: Thanks all. Postmortem owner: anna_sre. Closing thread after log export.
